## Checklist

- [ ] Every new figure has a report year and PDF page.
- [ ] Estimates are labelled as estimates in the `note` column.
- [ ] Wording says "the report records" or equivalent, not "stole", "fraud", or "lost".
- [ ] No personal contact details or identity numbers are added.
- [ ] If data changed, the affected R scripts were rerun and the CHANGELOG is updated.
